description: Update an existing New Quiz (LTI) in a Canvas course, found by its assignment_id (from list_assignments or get_assignment, filtered on is_quiz_lti_assignment, or from create_new_quiz — not a Classic Quiz ID). Only the fields you pass change; omitted fields keep their current value, so a repeated call with the same payload leaves the quiz unchanged. Pass null for due_at, unlock_at, or lock_at to clear that date. Returns the updated quiz (id, title, points_possible, due_at, unlock_at, lock_at, published, assignment_id). Use update_new_quiz_item to change an individual question instead of the quiz shell, and delete_new_quiz to remove the whole quiz. quiz_settings's flat fields (calculator, shuffle, time limit, access code, one-at-a-time) each change independently, same as the rest of this call, but its multiple_attempts sub-object is replaced as a whole by Canvas: passing { multiple_attempts: { max_attempts: 3 } } clears every other multiple_attempts sub-field (which score to keep, the cooling period, …) instead of leaving them as they were, so repeat every sub-field you want kept. IP-address access filtering and result_view_settings are not supported by this tool. Requires permission to manage quizzes in the course.

assignment_id.description: The assignment ID of the New Quiz

instructions.description: HTML instructions shown before the quiz starts

published.description: Whether the quiz is visible to students

quiz_settings.description: Quiz session settings. The flat fields above change independently of each other, but multiple_attempts is replaced as a whole nested object — see its field for what that means. IP-address access filtering and result_view_settings are not supported by this tool.

allow_backtracking.description: Lets students revisit earlier items; only applies when one_at_a_time_type is question

anyOf.description: Canvas replaces this whole object on update — any sub-field you omit is cleared, not left at its current value. Pass every sub-field you want to keep, not only the one you are changing.

attempt_limit.description: Caps attempts at max_attempts; false allows unlimited attempts

cooling_period_seconds.description: Used only when cooling_period is true

max_attempts.description: Used only when attempt_limit is true

score_to_keep.description: Which attempt score counts toward the grade

multiple_attempts.description: Replaced as a whole object by Canvas — see its own description. Pass null to clear it.

one_at_a_time_type.description: question shows one item per screen; none shows the whole quiz at once

session_time_limit_in_seconds.description: Used only when has_time_limit is true

student_access_code.description: Code students must enter to start the quiz

name: update_new_quiz
title: Update New Quiz
